findings.summary: Adversarial review round 1 [web]: dropping ehttp for ureq on std::thread reverses ADR 0001's wasm plan with no ADR, and std::time::Instant in Reads panics on wasm.
findings.reason: ADR 0001 is amended: native fetches with ureq and a 20 s deadline because ehttp's native GET has none before headers; the wasm entry (TRU-12) fetches with ehttp behind a target_arch cfg, so ureq is now a native-only dependency in crates/app/Cargo.toml. Reads keeps time with web_time::Instant, std's natively and the browser's clock on wasm.

findings.summary: crates/server/src/sources.rs:44: when one Linear repo fails, linear's last_good is set to now() while that repo's tickets are kept from an earlier read, so the stale line and the age metric say the data is fresh.
findings.reason: Linear::last keeps each repo's read time with its tickets; a failed repo's kept read time becomes the read's as_of (the oldest), which refresh uses as last_good. The test one_failing_linear_project_keeps_its_tickets_and_the_other_repo_updates now asserts last_good stays at the first read's time after a later read.

findings.summary: Adversarial review round 1 [operability]: Linear reads every repo as one all-or-nothing read, and a misspelt linear_project silently returns no tickets.
findings.reason: Linear reads each repo apart, keeps a failing repo's tickets and reports '1 of 2 repos failed, first: …'; an empty project logs a warning naming the repo and project. Tested by one_failing_linear_project_keeps_its_tickets_and_the_other_repo_updates.

findings.summary: Adversarial review round 1 [web]: with no board yet and a failed read, the panel keeps saying 'Loading from <url>…'.
findings.reason: It now says 'No board yet: the next read is due within 30 s.'

findings.summary: Adversarial review round 1 [web] and task review round 3: ages subtract the server's last_good from the client's clock, so a skewed device clock makes stale data look fresh.
findings.reason: The app tells ages by Reads::server_now: the snapshot's generated_at plus the time since it came back. Tested by ages_go_by_the_servers_clock.

findings.summary: Adversarial review round 1 [web]: nested sub-tickets don't name their repo.
findings.reason: A sub-ticket row shows its repo when it differs from its parent's; the board test asserts the bbooth/booking label on one.

findings.reason: Reworded as the plan: there is no wasm entry yet; TRU-12 adds it with ehttp behind a target_arch cfg.
